decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is core to the firm's announced direction of binding mobile communication and embodies substantial R&D, so management will persist even though it has not been visible on the website recently, possibly because it was folded into broader offerings.

The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is the publicly communicated backbone of the integrated identity platform, so dropping it would undermine the firm's positioning and earlier commitments.

The market is shifting to app-based authentication and the token has been absent from the website, but sunk hardware investment and remaining regulated customers lead management to keep it, possibly blaming weak demand on temporary market conditions.
The payment compliance suite supports the regulatory-security positioning the firm stakes its strategy on, and management can still attribute modest results to slow compliance adoption cycles.
